[Act: limitation
 Chapter: First Division · Part V · Suits Relating to Immovable Property
 Section: 61::
]


By a mortgagor—
(a)to redeem or recover possession of immovable property mortgaged;
Period of limitationThirty years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the right to redeem or to recover possession accrues.
(b)to recover possession of immovable property mortgaged and afterwards transferred by the mortgagee for a valuable consideration;
Period of limitationTwelve years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the transfer becomes known to the plaintiff.
(c)to recover surplus collections received by the mortgagee after the mortgage has been satisfied.
Period of limitationThree years.
Time from which period begins to runWhen the mortgagor re-enters on the mortgaged property.
